## Summary
<!-- What does this change do and why? -->

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (PATCH)
- [ ] New feature, backwards compatible (MINOR)
- [ ] Breaking change, e.g. incompatible DB schema or API (MAJOR)
- [ ] Docs / tooling only (no version bump)

## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass locally
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **[Unreleased]**
- [ ] Database changes are a new Prisma migration (not an edit to an old one)
- [ ] Tested the affected screens manually
